 1                P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   The 

 3    Senate will come to order.  

 4                 I ask everyone present to please 

 5    rise and recite the Pledge of Allegiance.

 6                 (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 7    the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.) 

 8                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   In the 

 9    absence of clergy, let us bow our heads in a 

10    moment of silent reflection or prayer.

11                 (Whereupon, the assemblage respected 

12    a moment of silence.)

13                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Senator 

14    Kennedy.

15                 SENATOR KENNEDY:   Good morning, 

16    Madam President.  

17                 There's a Concurrent Resolution at 

18    the desk.  Please read it in its entirety, and I 

19    move for its immediate adoption.

20                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   The 

21    Secretary will read.  

22                 THE SECRETARY:   Senate Resolution 

23    2, by Senator Stewart-Cousins, Concurrent 

24    Resolution of the Senate and Assembly relative to 

25    the adjournment of the extraordinary session of 


                                                                5597

 1    the Legislature sine die.

 2                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   The 

 3    question is on the resolution.  All in favor 

 4    signify by saying aye.

 5                 (Response of "Aye.")

 6                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Opposed, 

 7    nay.

 8                 (No response.)

 9                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   The 

10    resolution is adopted.

11                 Senator Kennedy.

12                 SENATOR KENNEDY:   Madam President, 

13    I move to adjourn the extraordinary session 

14    sine die.

15                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   The 

16    extraordinary session is adjourned sine die.

17                 (Whereupon, at 9:14 a.m., the Senate 

18    adjourned.)
